title: casselia lanceolata
intro: Casselia lanceolata, commonly known as Wild Fuchsia, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Casselia lanceolata include reducing inflammation, fighting bacterial and fungal infections, and alleviating fever. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
